children: A strong third-quarter performance in Europe wasn't just down to a sunny summer, Campari's chief executive says. The Italian aperitif maker noted good momentum in Europe that boosted quarterly sales by 3.4% organically over the July-September period. Sunshine that drew drinkers to Europe's bars and terraces may have helped a little, Simon Hunt says in a call. But execution of strategy and portfolio management was the key to the growth, Hunt says. "This wasn't a weather-led performance." (joshua.kirby@wsj.com; @joshualeokirby)
